headlines.title: Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company, which offers audits and safety certifications for AI agents, raised a $40M Series A, bringing total raised to $55M (Julie Bort/TechCrunch)
Meta rolls out its Meta One subscription bundle globally, with expanded Meta AI capabilities powered by Muse, and $7.99/month and $19.99/month individual plans (Stevie Bonifield/The Verge)
OpenAI says it has been working with Anthropic and Google for several weeks on AI safety, and it does not need an antitrust waiver to coordinate on safety (Maggie Eastland/Bloomberg Law)
At Dreamforce, Salesforce announces Koa, a specialized CRM reasoning model built on Nvidia's Nemotron architecture, designed to power AI agents in Agentforce (Mike Wheatley/SiliconANGLE)
Samsung and EU Scaleup Fund back efficient AI startup Euclyd in €200m Series A
AI infrastructure company Cornelis raises $205M to chip away at Nvidia’s dominance
Y Combinator Still Busiest Startup Investor In August As Nvidia Ramps Up Its Dealmaking Pace
Seattle’s Nuance Labs raises $50M to give AI models human expression and nuance
Meta says it plans to deploy MTIA 450, its third-generation custom AI chip, in data centers in H1 2027, followed by a broad rollout of MTIA 500 by end of 2027 (Dina Bass/Bloomberg)
Profound raised $180m at a $1.8bn valuation to sell brands visibility in AI answers
OpenAI backs a provision of the FRONTIER Act, a bipartisan House proposal, that would require AI companies to embed outside evaluators to ensure model safety (Brendan Bordelon/Politico)
Early Anthropic hire, former METR COO have found a way to rein in rogue AI agents
Sector Snapshot: AI Takes A Growing Share Of Sales And Marketing Startup Funding
Temporal raises $550M, hits $12.55B valuation as agentic AI wave fuels massive growth
Superhuman acquires YC-backed notetaker Fathom as productivity platforms push for agentic work
OpenAI’s top strategist calls the state-by-state route reverse federalism. Its president helps fund a super PAC trying to preempt the states.
Elon Musk says top US AI labs and "three or four of the leading Chinese companies" should let rivals run a "test harness" on their models to evaluate safety (Annie Palmer/CNBC)
Sam Altman says OpenAI won’t wait for Congress to slow down AI
Meta’s new One subscriptions put a price on social media and AI
America’s machinists are retiring, and two startup founders in their 20s want to salvage what they know
Anthropic expects a second straight quarter of adjusted operating profit
OpenAI backs binding UK AI rules as MPs call for a regulator
Tandem Health raises $100m to turn its AI scribe into clinic software
